stem.text: The diagram shows a cell of internal resistance $1.0R$ connected to a variable resistor.

stem.alt: Circuit with a cell and a resistor labelled 1.0R inside a dashed box, connected in a loop to a variable resistor.

stem.text: When the variable resistor has an initial resistance of $2.0R$, the current in the cell is $I_1$ and the terminal potential difference (p.d.) across the cell is $V_1$.
The variable resistor is now adjusted to a new resistance of $4.0R$.
What is the new current in the cell and the new terminal p.d. across the cell?
